description: Finite shared style-override resolution contract. No native rendering or general CSS certification.

fixture.renderer: Actual pinned React DOM SSR using original createStyled and a slot-selecting overridesResolver.

adaptations: Resolve every enumerable override slot before preparing selected native CSS. Preserve callback arrays, embedded variants, source getter/matching/throw order and callback receiver/arguments.
Prepared native sheets retain resolved styles for descendant recollection without new callback invocations.

Direct theme fields and deferred callback members of selected variant-style arrays remain native extensions. General Emotion serialization, processed Emotion CSS, modular CSS layers, arbitrary selectors and renderer-wide invocation counts are not certified.
